interpretation: The packet separates a machine-valid blocker/handoff from success. It fails closed when work is still Chat-capable, when the sender already possesses the required capability, when the protected effect was attempted, when evidence is stale/missing/mutable, or when CLEAN claims final acceptance. It is additive to the earlier action/authorization handoff packet rather than a replacement.
